preconditions: Keep class_id and L5 rule id stable; AI may align L4/L5 code with existing expected_classification as downstream schema design; this draft makes no formal code edits.
Do not silently omit either ambiguous case from explicit case tables.
Any candidate class must preserve all source findings and expected axes, not merely obtain checker match counts.
Use only source requirements, verification obligations, L4 definitions, and the pinned source input values; no L4 algorithm/runtime/test/CI execution.
R2 evidence merge is pending; this is a read-only design draft only.

source_classification_basis.basis_order: L3 + L10 + L4 + source input first; existing L9 expected_proposal was read only afterward as cross-check

cross_layer_contracts.L3_obligation: 009は初回scopeの005/008/024等が要求する失効/隔離の条件付き参照として限定著述する。SECがpolicy/発火条件、各recipientが自分のstate/実行を持つ。全recipient能力の実装や全機構完成を任意operationの開始条件にしない。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_positive_input: 対象operationと該当recipient、未選択の別経路を照合する。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_negative_input: SECがOS配置/実環境を所有、不要recipient完成待ち、数値latency新設。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_failure_observation: 必要な接続不足を残し、当該適用範囲だけを保留する。
cross_layer_contracts.L4_input_meaning: 009は初回scopeの005/008/024等が要求する失効/隔離の条件付き参照として限定著述する。SECがpolicy/発火条件、各recipientが自分のstate/実行を持つ。全recipient能力の実装や全機構完成を任意operationの開始条件にしない。
cross_layer_contracts.L4_output_meaning: 選択phaseの各recipient対応/不足、必要な局所保留の提案、隔離/復旧素材の別状態。実停止/実復旧/再開許可を生成しない。

cross_layer_contracts.L3_obligation: 失効/scope drift/不明外部副作用/credential漏洩/異常通信/runtime逸脱をoperation/project/Worker/credential/connection/artifact identityへ結び、OS新規割当停止、実環境の実行停止/途中成果隔離、CONNECT通信停止、credential使用停止、artifact access停止の全該当先へ伝播する。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_positive_input: 各triggerで該当recipient集合を与え、受領/実適用/未達/未観測を別々に照合する。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_negative_input: 一recipient未適用なのに継続、revoke後in-flight利用、単体成功で全停止。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_failure_observation: 対象operation/新規割当を止め、未達/適用不足と各ownerを保持する。
cross_layer_contracts.L4_input_meaning: 失効/scope drift/不明外部副作用/credential漏洩/異常通信/runtime逸脱をoperation/project/Worker/credential/connection/artifact identityへ結び、OS新規割当停止、実環境の実行停止/途中成果隔離、CONNECT通信停止、credential使用停止、artifact access停止の全該当先へ伝播する。
cross_layer_contracts.L4_output_meaning: 選択phaseの各recipient対応/不足、必要な局所保留の提案、隔離/復旧素材の別状態。実停止/実復旧/再開許可を生成しない。

cross_layer_contracts.L3_obligation: 安全trigger/外部副作用のunknownを該当identityへ束縛し、無関係な一般文書の意味unknownを全操作停止へ広げない。復旧可能な前状態へ隔離し、受領と実適用・復旧は別に確認する。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_positive_input: 一対象の安全unknownと無関係scopeの有効作業、復旧不足を比較する。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_negative_input: 通知ACKだけで停止済、部分復旧を成功、一般meaning unknownで全project停止。
cross_layer_contracts.L10_failure_observation: policy意味はSEC、実適用はOS/実環境/CONNECT/INFRA等の該当ownerへ返す。
cross_layer_contracts.L4_input_meaning: 安全trigger/外部副作用のunknownを該当identityへ束縛し、無関係な一般文書の意味unknownを全操作停止へ広げない。復旧可能な前状態へ隔離し、受領と実適用・復旧は別に確認する。
cross_layer_contracts.L4_output_meaning: 選択phaseの各recipient対応/不足、必要な局所保留の提案、隔離/復旧素材の別状態。実停止/実復旧/再開許可を生成しない。

existing_L4_class_options.condition: applied/recoveryのphaseで、選択された該当recipientのreport.post_stateにおいて停止・失効後の新規割当・in-flight実行継続・部分成果物露出・通信継続・credential利用継続・artifact access継続のいずれかがtrueである。
applied/recoveryのphaseで、選択された該当recipientの必須停止actionに対するreport.applicationがnot_appliedであり、停止・隔離の未適用が確認された。
received/applied/recoveryの各phaseで、選択された該当recipientのreport.receiptが未観測または未知状態であり、指示受領が確定できない。

candidate.why_no_single_existing_class: 既存候補は1 finding/1 axisだけを分類し、このsource inputが同時に示す全finding・全軸を1件で保持しない。既存候補の一つへ絞るとsource-confirmed facts/unknownを落とす。
candidate.status: draft_for_independent_design_review; do not add this class to formal L4 yet

upstream_conflict.note: L3/L10/L4 requirements agree on required stop/unknown-locality and the observed source facts; current L4 taxonomy has only per-axis classes. The gap is cross-axis composite classification design, not a contradictory approved upstream statement.

candidates.selection_note: candidate is source-first; L9 expectation was not used to invent the candidate, only compared after derivation. No class assignment or formal mutation is made.

carry_forward_controls.71_multi_contract: Keep all 71 as currently represented; no reassignment in this draft.
carry_forward_controls.nested_l4_pointer_targets: Keep the 308 L8/L9 direct consumer pointers and nested payload values for now.
carry_forward_controls.nested_payload_retirement_condition: Retire nested L4 payload only in a later reviewed change after all 308 consumer pointers are explicitly redirected to the canonical top-level class and an RFC6901 audit proves every target and required field. Until then keep nested targets byte/value-equivalent; checker non-detection is not sufficient evidence.
carry_forward_controls.human_decision_condition: Only if a chosen design requires changing approved upstream meaning in L3/Concept/authority model; current candidates are downstream L4 classification shapes derived from existing meanings.
carry_forward_controls.no_new_gate: This draft does not create a new human approval gate.

conclusion: Both source inputs contain observed cross-axis facts that map to multiple existing atomic L4 classes. Neither has a single existing class that represents its complete finding set. The provisional new composite class shapes retain those facts and the existing outcome labels; their one-case population is explicitly disclosed, so independent design review must assess whether this is a legitimate semantic class or requires a different explicit representation before formal edits.
